summary: Iran launches massive UAV attack on Iraqi Kurdistan targeting Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, and Khalifan with jets intercepting. Saudi Arabia intercepts drones launched from Iraq toward eastern oil facilities and Riyadh, demanding Baghdad prevent such launches. IDF eliminates three senior Hamas operatives in Gaza including internal security commander Wael al-Ladawi.
key_points: Iran-backed UAVs strike multiple cities in Iraqi Kurdistan Region with jets intercepting. (Source: @shin_persian/8555)
Saudi air defenses intercept drones from Iraq targeting oil facilities in eastern region and Riyadh. (Source: @inon_yttach/9690)
IDF kills Hamas internal security chief Wael al-Ladawi in Deir al-Balah strike. (Source: @manniefabian/58868)
Iran executes at least two January protesters in Isfahan; clashes reported near Alikhani Square. (Source: @VahidOnline/77559)
Satellite imagery shows damage to gas storage tanks at Saudi Baqiq refinery. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381412)
Jordan military intercepts two drones targeting eastern desert; no damage reported. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5799)
UAE reactivates diplomatic channels with Iran while doubling military ties with Israel and US. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85856)
Houthi spokesman claims drone attacks on Saudi oil supply lines from eastern Saudi Arabia. (Source: @New_security8200/203012)

sections.executive_summary: Iran launches massive UAV attack on Iraqi Kurdistan targeting Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, and Khalifan with jets intercepting. Saudi Arabia intercepts drones launched from Iraq toward eastern oil facilities and Riyadh, demanding Baghdad prevent such launches. IDF eliminates three senior Hamas operatives in Gaza including internal security commander Wael al-Ladawi.

points: Iran executes at least two protesters from January 2025 Isfahan demonstrations: Abolfazl Sepahi Badjani and Amirhossein Safri Hosseinabadi; families summoned for final visits; clashes reported near Alikhani Square between security forces and locals chanting 'Allahu Akbar'. (Source: @VahidOnline/77559, @mamlekate/104014, @rodast_omiddana/77925)

Putin praises Iran's 'mosquito fleet' of small fast vessels as highly effective in confrontation with US; Russia developing similar capabilities with Kalibr-armed small ships for precise heavy strikes. (Source: @presstv/200576, @SharghDaily/174854)
Zelensky claims Russia provides Iran satellite imagery of US bases in Gulf; Trump to inquire directly with Putin about accuracy. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5793)
Oil price drops to $88 per barrel, a 12% decline in 24 hours according to Iranian reports. (Source: @kianmeli1/90139)
Ukrainian drones strike military supply lines connecting Russia and Iran via Caspian Sea; Zelensky claims strikes on vessels used for Iranian military cargo shipments. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5801)

IDF eliminates three senior Hamas operatives in Gaza: Nukhba terrorist Amro Abu al-Rish (involved in hostage release), Hamas police commander Abdul Nasser al-Aziz Maqadma in north Gaza, and Internal Security chief Wael al-Ladawi in Deir al-Balah. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742, @manniefabian/58868, @inon_yttach/9692)

False alarm triggers Red Alert in Kissufim (Gaza Envelope, 15-second warning); IDF confirms drone in Nahal Oz was Israeli; no security incident. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68517, @idf_telegram/24746, @idf_telegram/24741)
Netanyahu departs for Washington to discuss Iran with Trump; aims to expand peace circle while maintaining security. (Source: @almogboker78/17829)
Israeli military shoots down drone over Jordan border; did not enter Israeli territory; origin under review. (Source: @manniefabian/58872)

IDF strike in Deir al-Balah kills Hamas Internal Security commander Wael al-Ladawi; military says he collected intelligence for senior Hamas officials and facilitated terror attack planning. (Source: @manniefabian/58868)
IDF eliminates Nukhba terrorist Amro Abu al-Rish in south Gaza; he participated in hostage release and recent terror planning against Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742)
Palestinian workers permitted to return to West Bank settlements and industrial zones starting tomorrow per security assessment and worker security procedures. (Source: @New_security8200/203019)
Red Alert activated in Kissufim with 15-second warning but determined false alarm by IDF. (Source: @tzevaadom_en/68517, @idf_telegram/24746)
Drone activity reported over Western Beqaa region: Zalaya, Midoun, Lucia, Yahmar. (Source: @redlinkleb/33340)
Drone strike hits Nabatieh al-Fawqa; details emerging. (Source: @redlinkleb/33372)
Explosions at weapons depot of 'opposition terrorist party' in Sulaymaniyah, northern Iraq; smoke rising from Kurdish separatist headquarters. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85849, @naya_foriraq/85845)
Massive UAV attack from Iran targets Kurdistan Region: Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, Khalifan; numerous jets intercepting UAVs. (Source: @shin_persian/8555)
Jet activity and UAV interception reported in Akre, Dohuk, Kurdistan Region of Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/8561)

Saudi Arabia intercepts drones launched by pro-Iran militias in Iraq targeting oil facilities in eastern region and Riyadh; demands Baghdad prevent territory use for attacks. (Source: @inon_yttach/9690, @Faytuks_Network/5795, @asafroz/51971)
Iraq joins Pakistan in condemning drone attacks on Saudi Arabia; pledges not to allow its territory used for attacks on neighbors. (Source: @yediotnews25/133286)
Satellite images show damage to multiple gas storage tanks at Saudi Baqiq refinery; white and black cooling covers visible on two tanks to prevent fire spread. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381412)
Houthi spokesman claims drone attacks on Saudi oil supply lines from eastern Saudi Arabia using UAVs, in response to Saudi drone intrusions into Yemeni airspace. (Source: @New_security8200/203012)
Saudi air defenses intercept drones launched from Iraq targeting eastern oil facilities and Riyadh area. (Source: @inon_yttach/9690, @asafroz/51971)
Jordan military intercepts two drones targeting eastern desert; no damage reported. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5799, @presstv/200587)
UAE reactivates diplomatic/economic channels with Iran, restoring Iranian airlines and 20,000 residents temporarily, while doubling military ties with Israel and US. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85856)
Pakistan condemns drone attacks on Saudi Arabia; Iraq joins condemnation. (Source: @yediotnews25/133286)
Oil price drops to $88, 12% decline in 24 hours. (Source: @kianmeli1/90139)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's simultaneous UAV offensive against Iraqi Kurdistan and proxy drone launches from Iraq toward Saudi Arabia demonstrate expanded regional reach and coordination. The execution of protesters in Isfahan signals internal repression amid external escalation. IDF's decapitation of Hamas internal security and police command in Gaza degrades governance but may trigger retaliatory attacks. Saudi Baqiq damage and Jordan interceptions indicate widening aerial threat envelope.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia demands Iraqi accountability while intercepting attacks; Iraq officially condemns launches from its territory. Jordan activates air defenses against drone incursions. UAE pursues dual-track diplomacy: economic re-engagement with Iran alongside deepened military alignment with Israel and US. Pakistan joins Gulf condemnation of Iranian-backed attacks. Russia publicly endorses Iranian asymmetric naval doctrine.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian strikes on Caspian Sea supply lines suggest expanding kinetic conflict between Iran-Russia axis and Ukraine. Satellite confirmation of Baqiq damage provides verifiable battle damage assessment. False alarms in Gaza Envelope and Nahal Oz indicate heightened Israeli air defense sensitivity. Houthi claim of Saudi oil line attacks implies continued Red Sea/Yemeni theater activity. Oil price drop reflects market anticipation of supply disruption resolution.
